article.title: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
article.summary: Kinshasa, October 26 Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) have announced the start of a trial of a new vaccine in an effort to contain the spread of Ebola.

article.title: Protesters kill longtime nurse treating Ebola patients in Congo
article.summary: KINSHASA, Oct 26 - Youths killed a longtime nurse treating Ebola patients in eastern Congo and other health workers were sheltering under police guard, health officials said on Monday, in the latest in a series of attacks that have been fuelled by misinformation.

article.title: Kenya releases first Ebola contacts from quarantine, milestone in containment efforts
article.summary: NAIROBI, Oct 26 - Kenya on Monday released from quarantine the first group of people who came into contact with its index Ebola patient, a milestone in its efforts to contain cases to a single infection cluster.

article.summary: In eastern Congo, fear and misinformation are complicating the Ebola outbreak. After losing her sister and father, 27-year-old Zawadi Kavira Musubao was told she had been poisoned. A pastor blamed evil spirits, while a traditional healer’s potion failed to help.
